name: vibeboard Self-Hosted Conference CFP
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-managed conference proposal forms, submissions, reviewer scorecards, speaker onboarding and event scheduling; no software-enforced submission quota published.
watch_out: Requires deployment to your own Cloudflare account and associated Workers/database/storage resources; Cloudflare usage limits and potential charges apply. Specialized for conference calls for papers, not a general survey SaaS. Email delivery integrations may incur costs.
